description: Computes z-scores and percentile ranks for specified metrics across a peer group dataset. Identifies a focal institution and highlights its position relative to peers. Use with IPEDS or custom peer comparison datasets to benchmark graduation rates, research expenditure, enrollment trends, or any institutional metric.

metric_columns.description: Numeric metric columns to benchmark (e.g. graduation_rate, research_expenditure)

id_column.description: Column containing institution identifiers (e.g. unitid, institution_name)

focal_id.description: Identifier value of your institution in the dataset (e.g. '123456' or 'State University')

label_column.description: Optional column with human-readable institution names for display
